title: comments and test titles across tests/, bin/ and lib/ write counts down: a set the tree grows, or a list's length beside the list, many of them already wrong
body:
Found by dc on 2026-10-24, reading tests/, bin/ and lib/ for counts written into comments and test titles, on vc's assignment, which hv approved. 0206 applied hv's rule to the tests' assertions and 0208 applies it to docs and help pages, so comments and titles were left. The rule, in the user-scope AGENTS.md: "No number of checks, tests, liberators or anything else goes into a doc, a guard, a test or a constant in code, and nothing is named by its position in a list ... A count already written down is deleted, never corrected." The extraction-grammar copies of this class are a separate issue, filed alongside to land before the 0.1.14 cut. This one waits until after the cut, and vc says when to build it.

**The read:** every comment line and every `@test` title in tests/, bin/ and lib/ that holds a number word from two upward, or a numeral before a plural noun. That was 1,260 lines, each read in context. Excluded: the fleet command's files (exempt under 0216, and leaving devbin) and lib/pages (0208 read them). The kinds left alone are 0208's: dated records, fixed pairs, design constants, closed partitions, exit codes, external facts, illustrative output. Also left alone, on vc's word: a number that describes the fixture the same test builds a few lines below. Each entry below gives the line by main 19d15680, the phrase, what it counts, whether it still holds against the tree, and a rewording that drops the number. The lines were checked when they were read, and the build checks each one again.

## Counts

A count of a set the tree grows, or a list's length written beside the list. Entries marked ALREADY WRONG disagree with the tree now.

- `lib/builtins:21` -- "settled by four tiers:" -- the tiers listed below it -- true (tier 1..4 listed at :23-32) -- "What belongs in the table is settled by these tiers:"

- `lib/builtins:287` -- "`fmt` formats four languages" -- the fmt.* catalogue rows -- true today (fmt.elixir, fmt.rust, fmt.swift, fmt.md; grep `^fmt\.` in lib/builtins), grows with each formatter -- "`fmt` formats several languages; `check format` used to verify one"
- `lib/cmd/release:318` -- "Not reachable through the three kinds" -- notes.kind values -- true (changelog | releases | command, lib/config.reference.yaml:554), a set the core grows -- "Not reachable through the shipped kinds, which print only the two verdicts"

Note also :361 "every site passes `words` or `restore_words`" is wrong (gw, aw, qw, _dd_tmp, _fullcycle_words) -- "Unreachable from every site, which all pass a plain indexed array"
